meta.method: CCO (Karch et al. 1999 style: each terminal attached at the bifurcation minimising total intravascular volume) grown off atlas-derived LM/LAD/LCx/RCA centrelines

murray_law.enforced: structurally: r = r_term * (downstream terminals)^(1/3) with equal terminal flows, so r_parent^3 = sum r_child^3 holds by construction

posterior_descending.caveat: The source RCA contour stops before the crux, so no posterior descending artery is anatomically anchored. This is the largest CCO-grown RCA branch reaching the posterior interventricular groove; its calibre is below the 1.5-2.5 mm of a real PDA.
